episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.summary: Cooper, a high school math whiz and martial arts expert, learns her parents are spies when they recruit her to join them in the secret government agency. The newly appointed teen spy takes on her first undercover assignment, which coincides with her school dance. The mission: apprehend an enemy teen spy and recover the code for a virus designed to render every mobile device useless.

episodes.title: My Sister from Another Mother... Board
episodes.summary: Tries to convince her parents that her brother, Ernie, who is a genius with computers but pretty clumsy at everything else, is ready to become a spy. However, Craig and Kira have a different plan and introduce them to their new little sister, Judy - a sophisticated humanoid robot disguised as a precocious 10-year-old.

episodes.title: Give Me A 'K'! Give Me A 'C'!
episodes.summary: Reluctantly agrees to try out for cheerleading with Marisa so they can spend more time together. Meanwhile, Craig tries to bond with Ernie over sports, but quickly learns his son's gaming skills are better online than on the field.

episodes.title: Off the Grid
episodes.summary: K.C. and Ernie team with their retired spy grandparents to rescue Craig and Kira from a dangerous mission.

episodes.title: Photo Bombed
episodes.summary: Marisa has been named a finalist in a photo contest and her winning photo could be in magazines and billboards everywhere; the only problem is her entry photo is of K.C.

episodes.title: How K.C. Got Her Swag Back
episodes.summary: When K.C. loses her confidence after making a big mistake on a mission, Marisa goes on her own mission to get her bestie back on her game.

episodes.title: Daddy's Little Princess
episodes.summary: The Coopers are assigned to protect Prince Promomomo and must hide the teenage leader in their home for a few days. But when K.C. and the Prince become smitten with each other, Craig quickly puts his spy duties aside to remind the Prince that as K.C.'s father, he is the king.

episodes.title: Assignment: Get That Assignment!
episodes.summary: When Agent Beverly from The Organization hassles K.C. for her last mission report, the same classified information that Marisa has inadvertently used as her class paper, the best friends must race against the clock to get the assignment back.

episodes.title: Spy-Anoia Will Destroy Ya
episodes.summary: When K.C.'s somewhat awkward brother Ernie brings home his new girlfriend Jolie, a smart and super gorgeous exchange student, K.C. is convinced she is really a spy.

episodes.title: Double Crossed (1)
episodes.summary: When The Organization assigns Junior Spy of the Year, Brett Willis, to go undercover as K.C.'s boyfriend for a mission, K.C. winds up having real feelings for him. Meanwhile, Craig and Kira receive alarming news that their old arch rival Zane is back and determined to destroy them.

episodes.title: Double Crossed (2)
episodes.summary: Zane has captured K.C., but her family has no idea because the evil agent has created a K.C. look alike to take her place and defeat the Cooper family.

episodes.title: Double Crossed (3)
episodes.summary: The K.C. doppelgänger gains access to The Organization, now Kira and Craig must race against the clock to save their daughter and the agency.

episodes.title: Stakeout Takeout
episodes.summary: When K.C. decides to take a must needed vacation during a stakeout to catch a notorious robber, Ernie finally gets a chance to "bake the biscuits" and prove to his dad and K.C., that he is more than just the computer guy.

episodes.title: The Neighborhood Watchdogs
episodes.summary: When Mrs. Goldfeder's house is robbed, K.C. recruits her dad to organize and lead a neighborhood watch group, much to his chagrin. Meanwhile, Trinitee enlists Pentatonix to help her deliver a special message to Petey.

episodes.title: First Friend
episodes.summary: K.C. goes undercover as a college student at The University of Maryland to befriend and protect the President of The Organization's daughter, Eliza. Meanwhile, Judy tries to talk Ernie into letting her join his Adventure Scout troupe.

episodes.title: Operation: Other Side Part 1
episodes.summary: K.C. and her mom work undercover in a correctional facility and have to face off against each other to maintain K.C.'s cover as a tough criminal and Kira's as a guard.

episodes.title: Operation: Other Side Part 2
episodes.summary: K.C. goes even deeper undercover into The Other Side's training ground and is close to getting the intel she needs, when she discovers Brett is her new training officer.

episodes.title: K.C and the Vanishing Lady
episodes.summary: The Cooper family tries to take a much-needed vacation from spying, but their plans are interrupted when a wealthy socialite vanishes from their resort and K.C. is determined to find out what happened.

episodes.title: Debutante Baller
episodes.summary: Kira tricks K.C. into participating in the mother daughter Cotillion Ball by telling her it's an undercover mission. But K.C. puts a damper on her mom's plans when she enlists Marisa to help her go from her usual tomboy drab to Debutant glam.

episodes.title: K.C.'s the Man
episodes.summary: K.C. goes undercover as a male cadet with Ernie to rescue an agent's son at an all boys' cadet academy.

episodes.title: Runaway Robot
episodes.summary: K.C. Cooper enlists the help of former spy and computer engineering expert Simone Deveraux when her family's sophisticated robot, Judy, runs away and is captured by enemy agents.

episodes.title: All Howl's Eve
episodes.summary: Ernie and Judy go to New York City to intercept an evil wolf serum, but their mission is interrupted when they run into Emma and Zuri ("Jessie") at a Halloween party. Meanwhile, Marissa and K.C. throw their own Halloween party at home, and K.C. dresses up as a spy to impress a new boy at school.

episodes.title: The Get Along Vault
episodes.summary: K.C. and Ernie get trapped inside a bank vault and must put aside their sibling rivalry in order to work together to escape.

episodes.title: Enemy of the State
episodes.summary: When a former foe needs the Coopers' help, the family has to decide if they can face the consequences of aiding the enemy.

episodes.title: 'Twas the Fight Before Christmas
episodes.summary: K.C. plans to give her dad the most perfect christmas gift of all, a surprise visit from his dad. When he arrives, she's the one who ends up surprised. It turns out that Craig and Poppa Earl not only don't get along very well, he also has no idea that they are all spies.

episodes.title: K.C. and Brett: The Final Chapter - Part 1
episodes.summary: Brett is back and his assignment is to eliminate K.C.! But when he can't bring himself to complete his mission, K.C. decides to help protect him from The Other Side.

episodes.title: K.C. and Brett: The Final Chapter - Part 2
episodes.summary: When K.C. enlists her family to help Brett escape from The Other Side, the Coopers find themselves in danger with enemy agents and The Organization.

episodes.title: Coopers Reactivated!
episodes.summary: K.C. is finally coming to terms with no longer being a spy, but when a feared criminal escapes, the Coopers are given a chance to rejoin the Organization.

episodes.title: Do You Want to Know a Secret
episodes.summary: When a college student shows up claiming to be a relative, Kira is forced to tell a family secret she's been holding for years. Meanwhile, Marisa and Ernie give K.C. tips on how to handle her first date with Darrien.

episodes.title: Rebel with a Cuz
episodes.summary: K.C. is known as a "good tissues" so she steps up by proving to everyone she isn't. Meanwhile, Ernie is angered when he finds out Kira likes Judy better than him.

episodes.title: The Mother of all Missions
episodes.summary: Kira reveals that her sister Erica is not dead but alive. She is in hiding from the Organization. When The Organization finds out they follow Kira to find out where they were. Meanwhile Ernie and Judy are back to their original beds.

episodes.title: Accidents Will Happen
episodes.summary: When Darien is mysteriously injured in an accident, K.C. tries to figure out who is behind it. Meanwhile, Craig becomes head of security for a vice-presidential candidate.

episodes.title: Brainwashed
episodes.summary: When K.C. learns Erica and Abby are working with the head of The Other Side to carry out an evil mission at the Presidential election party, the Coopers must act fast to stop the enemy agents.

episodes.title: The Truth Hurts
episodes.summary: Ernie tries to impress The Organization with his science skills and develops a truth serum. Things get out of hand when K.C. accidentally drinks it and has to complete an interview to help Marisa get a job.

episodes.title: Down in the Dumps
episodes.summary: To boost Ernie's self-confidence, K.C. and Craig tell him that he's in charge of their next mission, but secretly K.C. is really running point.

episodes.title: Dance Like No One's Watching
episodes.summary: When K.C. goes undercover in a retirement home as wise-cracking senior citizen Bernie, her disguise unexpectedly wins the affection of feisty senior, Irma.

episodes.title: The Love Jinx
episodes.summary: When Craig and Kira discover they were never legally wed, K.C. decides to throw them a do-over wedding.

episodes.title: K.C. Levels Up
episodes.summary: When K.C. has to find an undercover spy, who also recently killed someone; to pass a test for a promotion at The Organization, everyone at the Cooper's neighborhood potluck becomes a suspect. Meanwhile, Petey is on his own mission to try and scare Judy.

episodes.title: Catch Him If You Can
episodes.summary: When K.C. has to capture wanted computer hacker. Noah Stone, she finds herself in competition with teen bounty hunter, Pinky Carter, who is also determined to take the hacker into custody.

episodes.title: Sup, Dawg?
episodes.summary: When K.C. has to catch a ring of criminals smuggling fireworks, she reluctantly has to take on a new partner, canine spy, Dexter.

episodes.title: Tightrope of Doom
episodes.summary: In this one hour event, K.C. captures her one hundredth criminal. However, K.C. and her family soon realize that the 100th criminal -a suspect of a major art heist; is actually not guilty. Determined to clear his name, K.C. and her family assume a variety of identities in persuit of the legitimate perpetrator of the crime. This includes going undercover at a travelling circus thus engaging themselves in combative activity and peril situations, along with involvement of planned circus themed events such as the high wire act.

episodes.title: The Legend of Bad, Bad Cleo Brown
episodes.summary: K.C. , Ernie, and Grandma Gayle go back to the 70s to relive how Cleo Brown became the first female African American spy to work for The Organization.

episodes.title: Spy of the Year Awards
episodes.summary: Kira's big moment at the Spy Of The Year Awards is interrupted when the son of Tony "The Big Toe" Tolentino crashes the secret ceremony to avenge his father.

episodes.title: In Too Deep, Part 1
episodes.summary: K.C. and Ernie go undercover with a planet-loving group called the Volunteens, while Craig is getting in shape for his new assignment to protect an ambassador.

episodes.title: In Too Deep, Part 2
episodes.summary: K.C. is given a mission by the Volunteens organization that pits her against Craig and his assignment to protect the ambassador.

episodes.title: Virtual Insanity
episodes.summary: When K.C. goes into a virtual reality game to rescue Ernie, it becomes the craziest Halloween ever for the teen spies as they try to tackle the alternate universe and enemy agents Darci and Damon, the masterminds behind the evil game.

episodes.title: Undercover Mother
episodes.summary: When Scholastic Achievement Quarterly tries to interview K.C. for being the smartest student in her school, she disguises herself as her mom so she can be featured and hide her identity as a spy.

episodes.title: Trust No One
episodes.summary: When K.C.'s latest mission is compromised, she is tasked to find the mole in The Organization.

episodes.title: Holly Holly Not So Jolly
episodes.summary: As the Cooper family decorates the house for the holidays, K.C. begins to reflect on the many disguises and missions she has taken on as a spy in hopes she can get over her holiday blues and recapture the spirit of the season.

episodes.title: Collision Course
episodes.summary: The Coopers go undercover in a biker club to find Richard, the head of The Other Side. Meanwhile, everyone thinks K.C. is losing it when she claims she saw her evil cousin Abby, the enemy agent she eliminated

episodes.title: Family Feud
episodes.summary: K.C. and her family find themselves in an epic spy showdown vs. The Other Side when her evil aunt Erica and her family return.

episodes.title: Coopers on the Run
episodes.summary: K.C. and her family of spies, along with her BFF Marisa, are on the run from archenemy Zane in Rio de Janeiro when they must take on another spy like non before – the fierce and slightly bizarre enemy agent Sheena.

episodes.title: Welcome to the Jungle
episodes.summary: K.C., Ernie and Marisa are on the run from Zane and eccentric enemy agent Sheena in the heart of the Brazilian jungle.

episodes.title: Out of the Water and Into the Fire
episodes.summary: When Zane sabotages the Coopers' plane ride, it is up to K.C. to save herself and her family.

episodes.title: Web of Lies
episodes.summary: K.C. believes that someone tampered with her SAT test; Marisa expresses interest in becoming a spy.

episodes.title: Teen Drama
episodes.summary: K.C. struggles to make amends with Marisa after their fight; Marisa wants a recommendation for The Organization from K.C.

episodes.title: K.C. Under Construction
episodes.summary: Unbeknownst to K.C., Marisa leaks classified information; Judy's disagreement with Diane over the tooth fairy jeopardizes the sophisticated robot's disguise as an everyday 10-year-old.

episodes.title: The Storm Maker
episodes.summary: K.C. is tasked with tracking down a dangerous weather-controlling device on the same night as her homecoming dance.

episodes.title: Keep On Truckin'
episodes.summary: K.C. lies to The Organization about losing the weather machine and is sent on a new mission with Craig to recover the machine's power source.

episodes.title: Unmasking the Enemy
episodes.summary: K.C. sets a trap to reveal Brady's secret identity.

episodes.title: The Truth Will Set You Free
episodes.summary: When K.C. tells her family and The Organization that Brady is an enemy spy with The Alternate, the Coopers secretly work with Marisa to try and catch him.

episodes.title: Stormy Weather
episodes.summary: Ernie and Marisa team up to help K.C. stop Brady and The Alternate from launching The Storm Maker.

episodes.title: Deleted!
episodes.summary: When Judy freezes and starts saying that her memory is almost full, Craig realizes that it's time for her refresh and returns to The Organization to upload her experiences.

episodes.title: Second Chances
episodes.summary: K.C. realizes she misses Darien and goes to tell him, but he reveals he has a new girlfriend. K.C. lies and says she has a boyfriend and the two agree to go on a double date.

episodes.title: Revenge of the Van People
episodes.summary: Ernie hosts a group of young international agents while K.C. is away on a mission.

episodes.title: The Gammy Files
episodes.summary: Poppa Earl visits with his new fiancé, Betty.

episodes.title: Take Me Out
episodes.summary: K.C. is tired of being just friends with Darien; she wants to be his girlfriend and at least try to date again.

episodes.title: Twin It to Win It
episodes.summary: K.C. is assigned to protect a foreign diplomat at a university ceremony and must go undercover by joining the school's drumline to secure a key position next to the diplomat.

episodes.title: Cassandra Undercover
episodes.summary: Byron waits for K.C. to respond and she says she's not K.C. but her cousin, Cassandra. Byron suggests they all go to dinner, so K.C. breaks Bernice out of jail to play her cousin.

episodes.title: K.C. Times Three
episodes.summary: The team strategizes on ways to find Bernice when Ernie spots a composite sketch of K.C. on the news. Bernice has been robbing convenience stores all across the D.C. Area.

episodes.title: The Domino Effect
episodes.summary: The Coopers track down agents who are distributing weapons to enemy agencies, only to discover they are parents of K.C.'s classmate Amy.

episodes.title: Domino 2: Barbecued
episodes.summary: As K.C. continues to get closer with Amy, she plants bugs in the Bishops' house to get information on the weapon-distribution list.

episodes.title: Domino 3: Buggin' Out
episodes.summary: K.C. decides to save Ernie since it was her fault the barbecue failed. They learn the Bishops have planted listening devices and someone called the "The Mask" wants the weapons sold.

episodes.title: Domino 4: The Mask
episodes.summary: K.C. and Marisa take Amy on a trip to New York so she won't be at home to witness her "parents" being arrested by the Organization.

episodes.title: K.C. Undercover: The Final Chapter
episodes.summary: K.C. struggles to decide if she should continue as a full time spy or live a normal life at college.
